steps.content: The gray-haired Sinner collapses and has no strength left to manipulate the black substances, while the filth gradually corrodes her body.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content:
Don't do anything unnecessary, Chief.
The shackles can't suppress her Mania now and will only put you in danger.
You look at the girl at her last breath. Even until now, she is still trying to carry out that "order" but to no avail.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I have no sympathy for you.

steps.content: All she wants is not to turn into a monster, but Ted uses her and forces such heavy guilt on her. And she still can't escape being controlled even now.
The sad thing is that even though she gave up herself to become a killing machine, she still faces the same fate.

steps.speaker: Options
steps.content: Turn back. Don't repeat the same mistake.
options: Turn back. Don't repeat the same mistake.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: That man exploits everything you have by giving you false hope. He never planned to let you live, even from the moment he started to control you.
She shudders and her eyes sink.
Even if she was coerced, she is responsible for countless tragedies yet unwilling to repent. Her sins are too heavy to be forgiven.
The sarcastic thing is that even though she gave up herself to become a killing machine, she still faces the same fate.

steps.speaker: Options
options: This is what happens when you betray.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You became his lapdog and betrayed the people who really wanted to save you. You destroyed your hope with your own hands.
She pauses, stares fixedly into your eyes, and says nothing.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, time to go. We need to find Suspect R before Ted does.

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.content: Sorry. I'll stay with this kid. She is my patient, so it's the nurse's job to look after her.

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.content: ...Go, Chief. The man you're looking for is right ahead, in—
Bang, bang—!
Gunshots sound in the dark. Two bullets hit Anne, who tumbles down onto the ground.
Just when you try to hold her, a third shot shatters the gas tank in the cabinet. Unknown smoke quickly jets out and fills the room.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Cover your nose and mouth!
You did your best, but most of your strength is still drained. You fall to your knees. Hella and Hecate panic and lose the strength to move.
A cold muzzle pokes out from the passageway ahead, then Ted steps out with a gloomy and twisted look.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: ...I found the secret room, but there was no one in it.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Head nurse... where did your patient go?

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.content: Heh... Is that so? She escaped...? Great. Now I don't have to worry...

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Are you ***ing with me?!!!
The furious bullets are fired at Anne in quick succession. Because of his agitation, the shots are not fatal but put Anne in worse agony.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Bastard, where's the inheritance?! Where's that woman?!! I can't go back empty-handed after all this effort! Tell me!! What aren't you saying?!

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Filthy monster! ***! Stinky ***... I'll kill you here and leave a hundred holes on you, then throw you in front of your *** and make her tell me!

steps.speaker: Choice
steps.content: Stop!!
Bang, bang, bang—!!
Ted fires his gun frenetically, but none of the bullets hit Anne.
Several black spikes suddenly burst out from the ground, bouncing off all the bullets. In a moment of silence, you can hear the sound of crystals shattering behind you.
The gray-haired girl's arm is raised, but this time, it is aimed at her "master".
